$comment: Tool contract shared by every desktop-mcp port: names, parameters and descriptions must match this file. Generated from the macOS port (tools/list) and checked by each port's conformance test.

tools.description: Manages macOS applications with six modes: 'launch' (opens the application), 'resize' (adjusts active window size), 'move' (repositions active window), 'switch' (brings specific app into focus), 'quit' (asks every process with that name or bundle id to quit; the app may ask to save), 'force_quit' (terminates them without asking). Quit never targets desktop-mcp itself or loginwindow.
tools.name: App

tools.description: Execute commands on macOS. Modes: 'shell' (default) for bash/zsh commands, 'osascript' for AppleScript. Use for file system, process management, system operations, and automation scripts. SECURITY WARNING: Commands are executed with the same permissions as the terminal/application running this server. Review and understand all actions before execution, especially those involving file operations, system modifications, or external processes.
tools.name: Shell

tools.description: Captures complete desktop state including: focused window, open applications, interactive elements (buttons, text fields, links, menus with coordinates), and scrollable areas. Set use_vision=True to include screenshot with numbered annotations on interactive elements. Always call this first to understand the current desktop state before taking actions.
tools.name: Snapshot

tools.description: Performs mouse clicks at specified coordinates [x, y]. Supports button types: 'left' for selection/activation, 'right' for context menus, 'middle'. Supports clicks: 0=hover only, 1=single click, 2=double click.
tools.name: Click

tools.description: Types text at specified coordinates [x, y]. Set clear=True to clear existing text first. Set press_enter=True to submit after typing. Set caret_position to 'start', 'end', or 'idle' (default).
tools.name: Type

tools.description: Scrolls at coordinates [x, y] or current mouse position if loc=None. Type: vertical (default) or horizontal. Direction: up/down for vertical, left/right for horizontal. wheel_times controls scroll amount.
tools.name: Scroll

tools.description: Moves mouse cursor to coordinates [x, y]. Set drag=True to perform a drag-and-drop operation from current position to target coordinates.
tools.name: Move

tools.description: Executes keyboard shortcuts using key combinations separated by +. Examples: "command+c" (copy), "command+v" (paste), "command+tab" (switch apps), "command+space" (Spotlight). Note: Use "command" instead of "ctrl" on macOS.
tools.name: Shortcut

tools.description: Waits a fixed 'duration' in seconds, or with 'until' waits for a condition, checking with backoff until it holds or 'timeout' seconds (default 10) pass, then fails. 'duration' is ignored with 'until'. Conditions: 'app_running' / 'app_quit' ('app': name or bundle id); 'window' / 'window_gone' ('app' and/or 'title', a case-insensitive substring; 'window' returns the matching Window list lines); 'element' ('title' and/or 'role', an exact AX role such as AXButton, in 'app' or else the app owning the menu bar; title matches title, description or value; returns '<role> "<title>" at [x,y]', the centre in Click coordinates). Window and element conditions need Accessibility.
tools.name: Wait

tools.description: Fetch content from a URL. Performs a lightweight HTTP request and returns the page content as text.
tools.name: Scrape

tools.description: Manages Mission Control desktop Spaces. mode='create' opens Mission Control and clicks 'Add Desktop' to create a new virtual desktop, verifying the space count increased before reporting success. Uses Accessibility only. Requires Accessibility permission. UI layout can vary by macOS version/locale.
tools.name: Desktop

tools.description: Sends a macOS notification banner with a message, title, optional subtitle, and optional sound.
tools.name: Notification

tools.description: Opens a file, folder or URL with the default application, or with the application given by 'app' (name or bundle id). mode='reveal' shows an existing file or folder in Finder instead.
tools.name: Open

tools.description: Reads or writes the clipboard. mode='read' (default) returns the copied text, file paths and image; mode='write' replaces the clipboard with 'text' or with the files in 'paths' (which must exist), not both.
tools.name: Clipboard

tools.description: Lists or runs the user's Shortcuts (the Shortcuts app, not keyboard shortcuts). mode='list' returns the shortcut names, optionally only those in 'folder'. mode='run' runs the shortcut 'name' (exact name), passing 'input' text to it, and returns its output.
tools.name: RunShortcut

tools.description: Searches the Spotlight index for files. By default 'query' is words that must each appear in the file name or text; raw=true passes 'query' as a Spotlight query (e.g. kMDItemContentModificationDate > $time.today(-7)). 'scope' is a list of folders (default: home). 'kind' narrows the type. Returns up to 'limit' (max 200) lines '<path>\t<kind>\t<modified>\t<size>', newest first; content=true adds the first 300 characters of each plain-text file.
tools.name: Spotlight

tools.description: Lists and arranges application windows. 'list' (default) returns one line per window: '<id>\t<app>\t"<title>"\t[x,y,w,h]\t<flags>' (flags: focused, minimized, fullscreen), optionally only for 'app' (name or bundle id). The other modes act on the window 'id' from list: 'focus', 'move' (to 'loc' [x, y]), 'resize' (to 'size' [width, height]), 'minimize', 'restore', 'close' (presses its close button; the app may ask to save), 'maximize' (fills its display minus the menu bar and Dock), 'fullscreen', 'exit_fullscreen', 'display' (moves it to display index 'display', same relative position, kept inside that display). 'displays' (no id) returns one line per display: '<index>\t<name>\t[x,y,w,h]\tvisible [x,y,w,h]\tscale <s>', then 'main' for the main one, in the same top-left coordinates as window frames. 'maximize' and 'display' refuse a window in full screen. A window that closed since it was listed is refused; list again. An index id (no 'w') must also be listed again after 'fullscreen' or 'exit_fullscreen'.
tools.name: Window

tools.description: Reads and chooses commands from an app's menu bar ('app': name or bundle id; default the frontmost app). 'list' (default) returns an indented tree of item titles with keyboard shortcuts and [disabled], 'depth' levels deep (default 2, max 4), below the optional 'path' prefix. 'select' presses the item 'path' names from the bar item down, e.g. ["File", "Export…"]: titles match exactly, then ignoring case, then also treating '...' as '…'; the Apple menu is "Apple". A disabled item is not pressed.
tools.name: Menu

tools.description: Reports which macOS permissions desktop-mcp holds: Accessibility, Screen Recording, and Automation of System Events (granted, not granted or not determined), and which tools need each. Never prompts. A tool that needs a missing permission fails with a message saying how to grant it.
tools.name: Permissions
